blocks.text: Royal Heights Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Royal Heights has no City boundary for the board sub-area name, but a City corporate report describes a Royal Heights enclave bounded by Royal Heights Park to the north, 116 Street to the east, properties on 96A Avenue to the south and Princess Drive to the west, with 127 lots.
Royal Heights Park, at 9797 115A Street, is the area's defining park, listed by the City under Whalley and City Centre.
Royal Heights Elementary, at 11665 97 Avenue, sits inside that enclave pattern at its south side, on 97 Avenue east of 116 Street.

blocks.text: Royal Heights Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The enclave described in Corporate Report R017 holds 127 lots — a small, defined subdivision pattern, not an open-ended suburb — bounded by Royal Heights Park, 116 Street, 96A Avenue properties and Princess Drive.
Royal Heights Park itself is over 2.2 hectares, with forest on the west side and an open field on the east, established in the mid-1960s during the subdivision of the surrounding houses.
Park access streets name the subdivision's interior pattern: 97A Avenue at 115A Street, Crown Crescent, Princess Drive and Royal Crescent.

blocks.text: Royal Heights Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The enclave's zoning changed in 2026: Council minutes for April 13, 2026 record a rezoning from Comprehensive Development (CD) to the new small-scale zone for this Royal Heights area, adopted as Bylaw No. 21930 — confirm the current zone for a specific lot in City mapping, because older documents will still show CD.
Corporate Report R017 is the City report behind that Royal Heights rezoning, covering the 127-lot enclave bounded by Royal Heights Park, 116 Street, 96A Avenue and Princess Drive.

blocks.text: Royal Heights Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Royal Heights Park was established in the mid-1960s during the subdivision itself, so the park's forest west side and open field east side are original subdivision features, not later additions.
The park's access points are at 97A Avenue at 115A Street, Crown Crescent, Princess Drive and Royal Crescent — four interior subdivision streets, not an arterial entrance.
Royal Kwantlen Park, at 13035 104 Avenue north of Royal Heights, is a separate, much larger City park — do not confuse a “Royal” park listing with Royal Heights Park at 9797 115A Street.

blocks.text: Royal Heights Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Royal Heights enclave rezoning — 127 lots bounded by Royal Heights Park, 116 Street, 96A Avenue and Princess Drive; rezoning from Comprehensive Development (CD) to a small-scale residential zone; status: Bylaw No. 21930 adopted April 13, 2026, per Council minutes (as of November 3, 2026).
The R6 Scott Road RapidBus, from Scott Road Station to Newton Exchange along Scott Road and 72 Avenue, is the rapid route west of Royal Heights, reached via 96 Avenue and Scott Road.

Local TransLink routes 314 and 316 run via 96 Avenue and 116 Street at the enclave's south and east edges — route 314 toward Surrey Central and route 316 toward Surrey Central and Scottsdale, per their TransLink timetables.
No SkyTrain station sits in Royal Heights; the R6 connects at Scott Road Station and the R1 / local routes connect at Surrey Central Station.

blocks.text: Royal Heights Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check elevation and drainage lot by lot: Royal Heights sits above the Serpentine / Nicomekl lowland to the south, but neither Corporate Report R017 nor the Royal Heights Park page states a flood, slope or geotechnical status for any specific lot — use the City floodplain and hazard mapping for the address.
Check the current zone, not the historic CD zone: Bylaw No. 21930 (adopted April 13, 2026) changed the enclave's zoning, so a pre-2026 zoning printout for a Royal Heights lot is superseded.

blocks.text: Royal Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

19 houses sold in Royal Heights with a median price of $1,125,000 (the middle half sold between $1,057,500 and $1,302,500), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 21% sold above list. They had a median $476 per square foot, a median year built of 1960 and a median lot of 7,333 square feet.
